name: png-file-chunk1246
note: PNG signature, IHDR, gAMA, PLTE, chunk and text append, chunk cursor, and verify from m_png.cpp (117-460). M_ReadIDAT stays on the earlier PNG chunks. M_SaveBitmap is not in this band.
auditSeams: M_CreatePNG calls M_SaveBitmap, which is later in the file. This slice writes the signature and the IHDR, gAMA, and PLTE chunks, then records the save call and does not deflate. MakeChunk and StuffPalette are also later in the file. The CRC is the zlib CRC used by CalcCRC32 and AddCRC32. A missing palette writes zeros. A text chunk longer than 1048576 bytes is rejected. png_gamma replaces the passed gamma when it is not 0. A short write returns false and leaves the bytes already stored.
auditRationale: UNCredited m_png.cpp 117-460 (+344). The IDAT reader at 470-654 and UnpackPixels at 1202-1288 are already credited. A full tally line scan shows no overlap with 117-460.
auditUncreditedRangeCheck: uncredited_range_check.py --file src/common/textures/m_png.cpp --start 117 --end 460 and a full tally line scan → no overlap.
auditManagedLocJustification: M_CreatePNG calls MakeChunk, StuffPalette, and M_SaveBitmap. M_AppendPNGChunk calls CalcCRC32 and AddCRC32. None of those functions are source lines in this band. The managed port keeps the header layout, the chunk cursor, and the verify walk, and it carries the CRC table and the palette pack because those calls produce the bytes this band writes. The save call is a seam instead of the later deflate. That host surface is why the managed file is over 150% of the 344-line source.

The header is the PNG signature, an 8-bit IHDR, a gAMA of 45454.5 times the gamma, and a 256-color PLTE when the picture is paletted. Chunk append writes a big-endian length, the type, the bytes, and the CRC. Text is a tEXt chunk with the keyword cut at 79 characters. Verify requires the signature, an IHDR first chunk, one IDAT, and an empty IEND. A text chunk is stored and then skipped so the next seek covers only its CRC. Find returns a zero-length chunk as 0.
